% Include the code generated by lhs2TeX.
\input{lhs2tex/code-snippets}

% Set some lengths.
\setlength{\linenowidth}{1.5em}
\setlength{\blanklineskip}{\bigskipamount}

% A listing environment.
\usepackage{float}
\newfloat{Listing}{tbp}{lst}
\crefname{Listing}{Listing}{Listings}
\crefname{subListing}{Listing}{Listings}
\DeclareCaptionSubType{Listing}

% Reduce the amount of empty space between the listing and the caption.
\AtBeginEnvironment{Listing}{%
  \setlength{\abovecaptionskip}{\bigskipamount}%
}

% Define some style macros used by %format directives.
\newcommand\CodeOp[1]{\mathbf{\color{opcolor}#1}}
\newcommand\CodeKw[1]{\mathbf{#1}}
\newcommand\CodeTy[1]{\mathsf{#1}}
\newcommand\CodeLbl[1]{%
  % Locally redefine \Conid to typeset its argument as a label using
  % \mathsf and typeset the argument to \CodeLab with this change in place.
  {\renewcommand\Conid[1]{\mathsf{##1}}#1}}
\newcommand\CodeFlag[1]{\mathsf{#1}}

% The initial color for primitives.
\colorlet{opcolor}{darkviolet}

% Reduce code size.
\renewcommand\hscodestyle{\small}

% Adjust formatting of comments.
%
% Uses a grayish colour and uses (* ... *) to surround the comment. Before the
% comment some horizontal space (\qquad) is inserted.
\newlength\commentindent
\setlength\commentindent{2em}
\renewcommand\commentbegin{\hspace{\commentindent}\begingroup\color{black!80}\((\!*\)~}
\renewcommand\commentend{\(*\!)\)\endgroup}

\usepackage{etoolbox}

% Typesets the argument with linenumbers for code segments enabled. The
% numbering starts by default at 1 but different starting points can be given as
% an optional argument.
\newcommand\NumberedCode[2][1]{{%
  \linenoon
  \linenoreset[#1]%
  #2%
}}

% In some contexts we want to remove vertical space above and below code.
\newcommand\TightCode[1][0pt]{%
  \setlength{\abovecodeskip}{#1}%
  \setlength{\belowcodeskip}{#1}}

% Define the environments and settings for borrow-style code.
\usepackage{tcolorbox}

\newlength\abovecodeskip
\newlength\belowcodeskip
\newlength\codeboxsep

\setlength{\abovecodeskip}{\abovedisplayskip}
\setlength{\belowcodeskip}{\belowdisplayskip}

% Can be locally redefined to pass additional arguments to a {tcolorbox}
% constructed through a {tcolorboxcode} environment. This is especially
% necessary when using this environment through the lhs2TeX machinery as there
% it is not possible to pass additional arguments to the underlying environment.
\newcommand\tcolorboxcodeargs{}

\makeatletter
\newenvironment*{tcolorboxcode}{%
  \edef\tcolorboxcodeargs{[
    savedelimiter = hscode,
    colback = codecolor,
    colframe = codecolor,
    boxrule = 0pt,
    boxsep = \noexpand\codeboxsep,
    left = 0pt,
    right = 0pt,
    top = 0pt,
    bottom = 0pt,
    sharp corners = all,
    before skip = \noexpand\abovecodeskip,
    after skip = \noexpand\belowcodeskip,
    \unexpanded\expandafter{\tcolorboxcodeargs}
  ]}%
  \expandafter\tcolorbox\tcolorboxcodeargs
  \hscodestyle
  \let\hspre\(%
  \let\hspost\)%
  % Trick pboxed into recognising \end{hscode} as the end of the environment.
  \def\@currenvir{hscode}%
  \pboxed
}{%
  \endpboxed
  \endtcolorbox
}
\makeatother

\colorlet{codecolor}{white}
\sethscode{tcolorboxcode}

% Switches to the borrowed code style: golden keywords with a grayish
% background.
\newcommand\BorrowCodeStyle{%
  \colorlet{opcolor}{darkgold}%
  \colorlet{codecolor}{lightgray!25}%
  \setlength{\codeboxsep}{.5mm}%
  \addtolength{\abovecodeskip}{2pt plus 1pt}%
  \addtolength{\belowcodeskip}{2pt plus 1pt}%
}

\newcommand\SaveColumns[1]{\appto\SaveRestoreHook{\savecolumns[#1]}}
\newcommand\RestoreColumns[1]{\appto\SaveRestoreHook{\restorecolumns[#1]}}
\renewcommand\resethooks{\global\let\ColumnHook\empty}

% Used internally by the `reductionexample` environment.
\newcommand\reductioncolumnhook{}

\newcounter{reductionstep}
\newenvironment{reductionexample}[1]{%
  \setcounter{reductionstep}{0}%
  \begingroup
  \def\reductioncolumnhook{%
    \endgroup
    \RestoreColumns{#1}%
    \global\let\reductioncolumnhook\empty
  }
  \SaveColumns{#1}%
  \ignorespaces
}{%
%  \endgroup
  \reductioncolumnhook
  \ignorespacesafterend
}

\newcommand\stepref[1]{(\romannumeral #1\relax)}

\NewDocumentCommand\ExampleReduction{s}{%
  \reductioncolumnhook
  \smallskip
  \quad
  \stepcounter{reductionstep}%
  \strut\(\IfBooleanTF{#1}{\PReduce*}{\PReduce}\)\hfill\small(\roman{reductionstep})\,%
  \smallskip
}
